name: Martek the Exiled
summary: At the Mirage Raceway, Fizzle Brassbolts seeks pistons strong enough for the engine he hopes will carry his car into the air. He sends you with a letter to Martek the Exiled, camped in the Badlands.

sections.title: A Letter for the Smith
sections.body: After Salt Flat Venom, Fizzle tells you his new engine should make his car so fast it could fly. His trials have failed because he cannot forge pistons strong enough for the strain. He knows one smith who may help: Martek the Exiled, who knows more about metal than anyone. Martek camps far away in the Badlands with a goblin, and you carry Fizzle's letter to him.

sections.title: At the Camp
sections.body: At the camp, Martek greets you with suspicion. He asks if you have come over an axe made for Gath'Ilzogg or to reclaim Duchess Pamay's honor. If you have come for a fight, he says, it may as well begin now.

sections.title: Martek's Reply
sections.body: When Martek learns Fizzle sent you, his manner changes. Fizzle and his brother are among the few who do not want Martek dead. So Martek agrees to help make pistons strong enough for the strain Fizzle has planned. To Martek, the new car sounds like a volcano on wheels.

faq.q: Why does Fizzle Brassbolts need Martek's help?
faq.answer: Fizzle's new engine should make his car fast enough to fly, but his trials have failed because he cannot make pistons strong enough for the strain. Martek knows more about metal than anyone and may be able to help.

faq.q: Where is Martek the Exiled located?
faq.answer: Martek is camped in the Badlands with a goblin.

aliases: what quest comes before martek the exiled
faq.answer: Salt Flat Venom comes before this journey in the chain, and Indurium follows it.
